description_en: Queries the error log details of an instance within a specified time range
description_zh: 查询实例指定时间范围内的错误日志明细
name: DescribeErrorLogRecords

parameters.help_en:
The node role. Valid values:

db
mongos

Only ApsaraDB for MongoDB instances are supported
parameters.help_zh:
节点角色：

db
mongos

仅云数据库MongoDB版实例支持
parameters.name: role

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the query. The value is in the format of a UNIX timestamp, in milliseconds.

<notice>The data type of this parameter is Long. During the sequence of serialization/deserialization, precision loss may occur. Ensure that the value does not exceed 9007199254740991.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
查询开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒。

<notice>该字段类型为Long，在序列化/反序列化的过程中可能导致精度丢失，请注意数值不得大于9007199254740991。></notice>
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the query. The value is in the format of a UNIX timestamp, in milliseconds.
<notice>The data type of this parameter is Long. During the sequence of serialization/deserialization, precision loss may occur. Ensure that the value does not exceed 9007199254740991.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒。
<notice>该字段类型为Long，在序列化/反序列化的过程中可能导致精度丢失，请注意数值不得大于9007199254740991。></notice>
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 100
parameters.name: page_size

fields.help_en: The filter parameter. Set this parameter to filters
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The error log content to filter
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The filter conditions.

Only error log filtering for ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL, ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL, PolarDB for MySQL, PolarDB for PostgreSQL, and PolarDB for PostgreSQL (Compatible with Oracle) is supported
parameters.help_zh:
筛选条件。

仅支持RDS MySQL、RDS PostgreSQL、PolarDB MySQL版、PolarDB PostgreSQL版、PolarDB PostgreSQL版（兼容Oracle）的错误日志筛选
parameters.name: filters

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the query. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
EndTime.description_zh: 查询结束时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC 时间）

ItemsNumbers.description_en: The total number of log entries returned
ItemsNumbers.description_zh: 当前返回的日志明细总数

Category.description_en:
The log category. Valid values:
NETWORK: network connectivity log.
ACCESS: access control log.
-: general log.
COMMAND: slow log.
SHARDING: cluster log.
STORAGE: storage engine log.
CONNPOOL: connection pool log.
ASIO: asynchronous I/O log.
WRITE: slow update log.

Only ApsaraDB for MongoDB instances are supported
Category.description_zh:
日志类别，取值：
NETWORK：网络连接日志。
ACCESS：访问控制日志。
-：普通日志。
COMMAND：慢日志。
SHARDING：集群日志。
STORAGE：存储引擎日志。
CONNPOOL：连接池日志。
ASIO：异步 IO 日志。
WRITE：慢更新日志。

仅云数据库 MongoDB 版实例支持

ConnInfo.description_en:
The log connection information.

Only ApsaraDB for MongoDB instances are supported
ConnInfo.description_zh:
日志连接信息。

仅云数据库MongoDB版实例支持

Content.example: 2025-07-15T15:14:27.175188+08:00 0 [Note] [MY-012468] [InnoDB] Transactions deadlock detected, dumping detailed information.

CreateTime.description_en:
The time when the error log was generated. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

<notice>For ApsaraDB for MongoDB instances, the time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC).></notice>
CreateTime.description_zh:
错误日志生成时间。格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒。

<notice>对于云数据库MongoDB版实例，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC 时间）。></notice>

DBInstanceName.description_en:
The node ID.

Only ApsaraDB for MongoDB instances are supported
DBInstanceName.description_zh:
节点ID。

仅云数据库MongoDB版实例支持

Db.description_en:
The database name.
Only certain special logs of ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL and PolarDB for PostgreSQL instances are supported
Db.description_zh:
数据库名。
仅RDS PG、PolarDB PG实例部分特殊日志支持

User.description_en:
The database account.
Only certain special logs of ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL and PolarDB for PostgreSQL instances are supported
User.description_zh:
数据库账号。
仅RDS PG、PolarDB PG实例部分特殊日志支持

UserIp.description_en:
The client IP address.
Only certain special logs of ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL and PolarDB for PostgreSQL instances are supported
UserIp.description_zh:
客户端IP。
仅RDS PG、PolarDB PG实例部分特殊日志支持

MaxRecordsPerPage.description_en: The maximum number of records per page
MaxRecordsPerPage.description_zh: 每页显示的最大记录数

PageNumbers.description_en: The page number of the current query

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the query. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
StartTime.description_zh: 查询开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC 时间）

TotalRecords.description_en: The total number of log entries within the query time range
TotalRecords.description_zh: 查询时间范围内的日志明细总数

Message.description_en:
The returned message.
If the request is successful, Successful is returned. If the request fails, an error message that contains information such as an error code is returned
Message.description_zh:
请求返回消息。
请求成功时该参数返回Successful，请求失败时会返回请求异常信息（如错误码等）

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:

true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
请求是否执行成功：

true：执行成功。
false：执行失败
